name: drive_book_voice_service_api
description: API for AI voice agent to interact with DriveBook platform for booking driving lessons. The hybrid voice service exposes these `/api/_*` endpoints and proxies them to the main DriveBook application.  RECOMMENDED AI CONVERSATION FLOW (OPTIMIZED): 1. Ask user for pickup location 2. Validate location via /locations/validate 3. Get smart recommendations via /instructors/recommendations (AI-ranked, top 3) 4. Present options: "I found 3 great instructors: Debesay (top rated), Michael (best value), Sarah (closest)" 5. User selects instructor 6. Call /availability/slots to check times 7. Call /packages to present package options with savings 8. Create booking via /public/bookings/bulk (backend calculates pricing, generates password)  KEY IMPROVEMENTS: - AI does NOT ask for password (backend generates secure password automatically)
